name: Fifth National Climate Assessment Chapter 13: Transportation
known_limitations: The assessment synthesizes national and regional evidence. It does not establish the condition, adaptation plan, funding, construction, or resilience of a named local asset.
automation_notes: Track the next national assessment and named federal, state, and local transportation adaptation records.
notes: Chapter 13 identifies climate exposure and adaptation needs across transportation planning, design, operations, maintenance, workforce, and technology.
